name: Aramaic
notes: STRUCTURAL CONTACT / ANCESTRY STUB (not a modelled G2P target). Aramaic is a Northwest (Central) Semitic language, for centuries the lingua franca of the Near East and the principal adstrate/substrate of Hebrew, of the Mesopotamian and Levantine Arabic dialects, and a co-liturgical language. It exists so that specs that reference it as a contact node have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. A table needs a cited description of one Aramaic writing system (for example the Syriac or the Square script) and the sound value of each letter.
